facility.name: Butterfly Schoolhouse
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver was missing training topics in food allergies and administering medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: The classroom had electrical outlets that were left uncovered at the time of the inspection. They were covered during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One child's immunization record was not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Observed the water hose loosely wrapped around the hose reel, creating a tripping hazard.     This was corrected when the provider wrapped the hose around the Hose reel tightly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: Fire extinguisher observed in the home was not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child's admission paperwork did not have the authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three children did not have admission paperwork or information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children's admission paperwork did not have a name, address, and telephone number of another responsible individual (friend or relative) who should be contacted in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two children's admission paperwork did not have the name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One child did not have current immunizations.  This was corrected when the parent sent the provider the updated immunizations during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child did not have any immunizations with their admission paperwork or in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two children were able to leave the backyard due to lack of supervision. The children were alone for several minutes before caregivers realized they were gone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under two were watching cartoons on television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The provider did not complete the annual certification of children's products.  The one posted was last completed in 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: One infant did not have any infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: There were 16 children in care at the home during inspection.  6 children were sent home during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: One infant was observed in a crib laying propped up on a boppy pillow.  The infant crib also had a bottle inside of it with the infant.  The caregiver removed the infant from the crib during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The kitchen counter had a large knife that was accessible to children.  The knife was moved during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training: Personnel and training records were not available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There was garbage accessible to children in the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §747.3203(8))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: The kitchen island had all purpose cleaner accessible to children in care as it was sitting on top of the island.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.  A head count was done during inspection to figure out how many children were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing: The children's records were not available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The provider did not have the letter or form from the most recent Licensing inspection or investigation posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was present at the operation and caring for children without an eligible/active background check.  The caregiver left during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation was not conducting monthly fire extinguisher inspections.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Home - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles: The home has a tortoise that the children feed and have contact with.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Home - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles (26 TAC §747.3705(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A household member was present without an eligible background check.  The provider submitted a background check during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has only done one fire drill and the exit time was ten minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: One household member did not have documentation verifying orientation to the child-care home was completed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no documentation of fire drills being conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: Caregivers updated background check has been verified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Children's records were available for review.  1 of 4 records reviewed was missing the admission date, 2 of 4 records was missing the health statement and 1 of 4 reviewed was missing the emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: The provider was caring for 13 children ages 18 months to 4 years.  A child was sent home during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
